location.address_or_site: 6990 W Kuna Mora Road; northeast corner of Kuna-Mora Road and Cole Road

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11. City of Kuna records identify Brisbie LLC's Project Peregrine data-center campus at 6990 W Kuna Mora Road, with a 2022 design review approval and a May 23, 2023 design-review modification for two data-center buildings, three ancillary buildings, and two guardhouse entrances totaling about 875,367 square feet; city staff also reported water and wastewater infrastructure under construction. Meta's official pages report a 2022 groundbreak and construction ramp-up in October 2023. IPUC/Idaho Power records show an approved Brisbie special-contract tariff for electric service, effective revisions through 2026, and associated renewable-resource PPAs, but no public CO, energization date, or Meta operational/live announcement was located.
evidence_grade: A- for local design-review/site-work and electric-service-contract evidence from City of Kuna, IPUC, and Idaho Power tariff records; B-/unverified for facility MW capacity and operational status because public sources do not provide a final CO, energization date, or official live-service confirmation.

history.previous: Meta’s official community pages report a 2022 groundbreak/announcement and construction ramp-up in 2023. No final building permit, inspection/CO, Idaho Power energization, or operational-service record was located; the Phase 2 end-2026 target is not treated as a completion fact.
history.updated: site work-construction as of 2026-08-11, backed by City of Kuna design-review modification and Meta construction updates; operational status remains unverified.

updated.address_or_site: 6990 W Kuna Mora Road; northeast corner of Kuna-Mora Road and Cole Road

actions.result_status: The East Kuna Industrial Annexation was approved by City Council on October 19, 2021, with findings signed November 3, 2021; the subject parcels were included within the M-1 Development Agreement executed December 15, 2021.
actions.access_caveat: Cited in the May 23, 2023 City of Kuna Planning and Zoning packet for Case No. 22-04-DR Modification; underlying annexation agreement not separately retrieved in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government entitlement context for the same Brisbie parcels.

actions.government_body: City of Kuna Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.result_status: City staff reported that Design Review for the subject site had been approved by the Commission on March 22, 2022.
actions.access_caveat: Referenced in the later 2023 modification packet; original 2022 approval document not separately retrieved in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government design-review approval, not a certificate of occupancy.

actions.government_body: Meta Data Centers (company source; not a government body)
actions.result_status: Meta announced the Kuna data center and said construction would proceed; the location and project identity are company-reported.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; exact groundbreak day and local permit number are not published there.
actions.evidence_note: Announcement and anticipated construction, not proof of permit or service.

actions.government_body: City of Kuna Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.result_status: City staff packet for Project Peregrine identified Brisbie LLC at 6990 W Kuna Mora Road, 242.7 acres, M-1 zoning, and a requested redesign for two data-center buildings, three ancillary buildings, and two guardhouse entrances totaling approximately 875,367 square feet; staff found the modification compliant and recommended approval subject to conditions including building permit issuance before site improvements other than blasting and rough grading.
actions.access_caveat: Packet text includes staff recommendation and proposed commission decision language; it verifies the application/site facts and local-process milestone, but not a final CO.
actions.evidence_note: Local-government record supports approved/permitted-local-process and site-work/construction classification.

actions.government_body: Meta Data Centers (company source; not a government body)
actions.result_status: Meta reported that construction was ramping up and named local partners including the City of Kuna and Idaho Power.
actions.access_caveat: Operator update; no permit, inspection, CO, or energization identifier is published.

actions.result_status: IPUC Order No. 35777 approved Idaho Power's special contract and Tariff Schedule 33 to provide electric service to Brisbie LLC's data center facility; IPUC's May 12, 2023 release describes the service as for a new data center in the Kuna area.
actions.access_caveat: Electric-service special-contract approval; not proof that facility load has been energized.
actions.evidence_note: Official utility-regulatory evidence that Brisbie is the service counterparty and exceeds ordinary large-power thresholds.

actions.result_status: IPUC Order No. 36572 approved the 20-year Blacks Creek PPA; the order states the PPA is for 320 MW AC of solar generation, scheduled COD December 31, 2027, and that Brisbie is identified as third-party beneficiary for the output and green tags.
actions.access_caveat: Renewable-resource nameplate capacity supports procurement context only; it is not data-center facility capacity.
actions.evidence_note: Power-supply association for Brisbie special contract.

actions.government_body: Idaho Public Utilities Commission / Idaho Power
actions.result_status: Current Idaho Power tariff includes Schedule 33 for Brisbie LLC's special contract dated December 22, 2021, amended March 14, 2024; pricing elements relying on the most recently filed IRP are effective January 1, 2026, pursuant to Order No. 36847 and approved February 5, 2026 per Order No. 36928.
actions.access_caveat: Tariff record confirms continuing service-rate framework, not actual energization or operational status.

actions.government_body: Ada County Development Services / City of Kuna / Idaho Power
actions.result_status: The reviewed Ada County permitting, Kuna archive, and Idaho Power public search surfaces did not expose a final Meta building permit, CO, project-specific interconnection, or energization date.
actions.access_caveat: Jurisdictions use separate systems; the county page notes other jurisdictions may hold the record.
